name: goyangi-layout-check
description: Renders the Goyangi terminal panel with Ink at several widths to find layout breaks

scripts.matrix: for k in ghostty wezterm herdr iterm; do for m in pane band; do for v in "" avatar; do echo "== $k $m ${v:-flow}"; TERM_KIND=$k MODE=$m VIEW=$v node check.mjs 2>/dev/null || r=1; done; done; done; exit ${r:-0}
